title: Airport/ space station
content: Has anyone had a dream where they’re traveling to another country (mine was Taiwan) and they’re at an airport but then suddenly they’re in a rocket ship and in the cockpit and getting ready to blast off and there in seconds? I had this dream a few years ago and still remember vividly. I was with my mom and we were there in a matter of seconds enjoying food and scenery, then I forgot something and had to prep to launch back. I could see space form my window and the earth while I was in the air
